records.performance_summary: AI Cardiac Auto Doppler (pp.11-13): testing sets of 4106 recordings from 805 individuals (Tissue Doppler) and 3390 recordings from 1369 individuals (Doppler Trace); adult and pediatric, male/female, USA/Australia/France/Spain/Norway/Italy/Germany/Thailand/Philippines, 8 Vivid console types and 14 probes. Acceptance: feasibility score >95% and mean absolute percent error per parameter under a threshold; 'All clinical parameters, as performed by AI Cardiac Auto Doppler without user edits passed this check'. BMI subgroup (41 patients, 433 Doppler measurements): agreement metric between manual and AI peak velocities for tissue Doppler mean -0.002 (SD 0.077) BMI<25 and -0.006 (SD 0.081) BMI>=25; flow Doppler 0.021 (SD 0.073) and 0.003 (SD 0.057). Development sets: 1482 (Tissue Doppler) and 2070 (Doppler Trace) recordings from 4 sites not used for testing; ground truth by two cardiologists per ASE guidelines with 5-expert review panel. AI FlexiViews LAA (pp.14-15): verification set 342 recordings from 84 adults (USA, Norway, Italy, France, Philippines; BMI 18.5->30; 6VT probe on Vivid E95/S70N/iq/Pioneer); expected >80% success; 'The model achieved a verification success rate of 85%, with a sensitivity of 84.91% and a specificity of 91.82%'; success >=80% across TEE angles 0-100 degrees; >85% accuracy for BMI>25. Development set 612 recordings from 5 sites independent of verification. No clinical studies.

notes: All seven summaries read in full from the local text files; no web search was needed. The four July 2022 clearances (K220619, K221148, K221147, K220882) share a verbatim AI testing section for Easy Auto EF and Easy AFI LV (AI Auto ROI algorithm, average Dice >=91-92%, 45 exams/135 images). 'Introduced in this K' is set true for those because each summary lists the features under 'Added' software relative to its predicate; they were cleared in parallel across the Vivid line, not sequentially. K251169 (Vivid Pioneer) introduces two new cardiac AI features (AI Cardiac Auto Doppler and AI FlexiViews LAA) with the most detailed performance reporting in the group; it also lists Auto Tissue (automatic gain optimization) and cSound Pioneer reconstruction, which are described as image-processing algorithms, not AI. K243628 and K243620 (Feb 2025 Vivid T9/T8 and Vivid iq) contain no AI-designated feature or AI test section; their only new image-processing feature is Clarity+ (speckle reduction). Because their predicates (K221147, K221148) carried Easy Auto EF / Easy AFI LV, the parent may reasonably treat those two as carry-over cardiac-AI platform clearances, but per the grounding rule they are flagged false with 'AI feature not identifiable in summary'. Page numbers refer to the PDF page markers in the extracted text files.
